name: Inexorable Tide
oracle_text: Whenever you cast a spell, proliferate. (Choose any number of permanents and/or players, then give each another counter of each kind already there.)
blocked_sentences: Whenever you cast a spell, proliferate.

needs.what: a full proliferate (701.34): the controller chooses any number of permanents AND/OR players that have counters (including opponents' permanents and players' poison/energy counters), then each chosen gets one more counter of each kind already there
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The existing `proliferate` op (options: objects only) is a simplification: it offers no choice and never touches players or opponents' permanents, so it would add counters the controller may not want and miss poison counters on opponents
